sourceReviewSummary: Verified against Fresno Unified’s official calendar page and revised/approved 2026–27 academic calendar PDF.
sourceReviewDetails: Calendar version: Board revised/approved March 11, 2026; originally board approved February 25, 2026.

We checked the first day, last day, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, student holidays, District Buyback Days, early-release Tuesdays, board approval information, and student instructional-day total.
The official 2026–27 calendar lists one District Buyback Day on August 12 followed by Teacher Institute Days on August 13–14 before the first student day.
The official calendar also lists District Buyback Days on October 12 and March 8 during the academic year.
This page focuses on districtwide calendar dates and does not independently verify school-level events, bell schedules, athletics, testing, transportation notices, or same-day announcements.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Fresno Unified start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Fresno Unified students begin the 2026–27 school year on Monday, August 17, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Fresno Unified in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Thursday, June 10, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Winter Break for Fresno Unified in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 21, 2026, through Friday, January 8, 2027. Students return Monday, January 11.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Spring Break for Fresno Unified in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 22, through Monday, March 29, 2027. Students return Tuesday, March 30.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Fresno Unified have a fall break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Fresno Unified does not list a separate October fall break. Students have no school on the October 12 District Buyback Day, followed by Thanksgiving Break from November 23 through November 27.

calendarFaqs.q: What is a District Buyback Day?
calendarFaqs.a: A District Buyback Day is a non-student day used for staff training and professional development. Fresno Unified’s 2026–27 calendar lists buyback days on August 12, October 12, and March 8. August 12 falls before the first student day, while October 12 and March 8 are no-school days during the academic year.

calendarFaqs.q: How do I add the Fresno Unified calendar to Google Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Download the .ics file from this page, then import it into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook. The file is a one-time snapshot and will not update automatically if Fresno Unified revises its calendar.
